description: The landings (type arrivals) or takeoffs (type departures) of airline flights at an airport in one airport-local day, read off positions reported by aircraft transponders, not from any airline or airport record. A movement belongs to the day its bracket starts in. Each movement is a bracket, not an instant: it happened between earliest_utc and latest_utc, the last position certainly in the air (at least 300 m above the airport) and the first on the ground for a landing, the reverse for a takeoff, at most 10 minutes apart; each comes with its callsign, the aircraft's ICAO 24-bit address and, when observed, the same flight's other movement (paired). These are not gate times, and no schedule, delay or on-time verdict is given. Only aircraft broadcasting an airline callsign are listed. An airport where no position on the ground is received yields nothing, and at one within a few km of another airport, movements that cannot be told apart from the other airport's are not listed. A movement is provisional until the UTC hour of the position that completed it has ended and 20 more minutes have passed (at most 80 minutes): until then a late position can still narrow its bracket, settle or clear its callsign, or withdraw it. complete says whether every movement of the day has settled. Pages are ordered by earliest_utc, then icao24; total counts every movement of the day: while next_cursor is not null, call again with the same airport, type and date and cursor set to it.

airport.description: Airport IATA code (e.g. LHR) or ICAO code (e.g. EGLL).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous answer, to read the next page; give the same airport, type and date with it. Omit for the first page.

date.description: Airport-local date YYYY-MM-DD within the last 89 days. Defaults to today at the airport.

limit.description: Max movements per page (1-100). Defaults to 50.

type.description: arrivals for landings, departures for takeoffs.

name: list_airport_movements
title: Observed airport landings and takeoffs
